import math

# Data for FY 2007-2013
outlays = [6008, 6345, 6643, 7185, 7295, 7228, 7066]
years = [2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013]

print("Outlays:", outlays)

# Calculate YoY growth rates
yoy_growth = []
for i in range(1, len(outlays)):
    rate = (outlays[i] - outlays[i-1]) / outlays[i-1] * 100
    yoy_growth.append(rate)
    print(f"YoY {years[i-1]}->{years[i]}: {rate:.6f}%")

print("All YoY Growth Rates:", yoy_growth)

# Average YoY growth rate
avg_yoy = sum(yoy_growth) / len(yoy_growth)
print(f"Average YoY Growth Rate: {avg_yoy}")

# OLS regression: ln(outlays) on fiscal year index
# Year index: 2007=0, 2008=1, ..., 2013=6
X = [y - 2007 for y in years]  # Convert to 0-indexed: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6]
Y = [math.log(o) for o in outlays]

n = len(X)
sum_x = sum(X)
sum_y = sum(Y)
sum_xy = sum(x*y for x,y in zip(X,Y))
sum_x2 = sum(x**2 for x in X)

# OLS slope and intercept
# slope = (n*sum_xy - sum_x*sum_y) / (n*sum_x2 - sum_x^2)
# intercept = (sum_y - slope*sum_x) / n
denominator = n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2
slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / denominator
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nOLS Regression:")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# R-squared

avg_yoy_rounded = round(avg_yoy, 3)
slope_rounded = round(slope, 3)
intercept_rounded = round(intercept, 3)

print(f"\nFinal rounded values:")
print(f"Average YoY Growth Rate: {avg_yoy_rounded}")
print(f"OLS Slope: {slope_rounded}")
print(f"OLS Intercept: {intercept_rounded}")

# Format as required: [avg_yoy, slope, intercept]
